proof_controls.q_plus_one: For q=1..4 on unequal block sizes 3,2,1, observed counts were q+1 positives, exactly q words per block and q+1 distinct projections for every cross-block pair; all four sparse certificates replayed.
proof_controls.unequal_three_positive_counterexample: At q=2 with block sizes (2,4), pair {b,f} had exactly {bbff, ffbb}; observed graph had 7 of 8 complete bipartite edges. The sparse provider still certified the intended partition.
proof_controls.proof_review: The q+1 proof is a construction, not a universal lower bound. The counterexample refutes only the specified naive unequal-size extension of the equal-size three-positive construction. Unique-color replay validates the clique, every forced-color witness, complete vertex coverage, and final proper coloring.

performance_interpretation: This was correctness validation, not an official performance comparison. The capture runtime is not reported as a provider benchmark. No official timing or memory work was performed.
